keyPoints.en: 622 CE: the Prophet ﷺ migrated with Abu Bakar after the Quraisy plotted to kill him.
keyPoints.bm: 622 M: Rasulullah ﷺ berhijrah bersama Abu Bakar selepas Quraisy berpakat untuk membunuh baginda.

keyPoints.en: Ali slept in his bed; they hid 3 nights in Gua Thur.
keyPoints.bm: Ali tidur di katil baginda; mereka bersembunyi 3 malam di Gua Thur.

keyPoints.en: Roles: Asma' (food), Abdullah bin Abu Bakar (news), Amir bin Fuhairah (sheep), Abdullah bin Uraiqit (guide).
keyPoints.bm: Peranan: Asma' (makanan), Abdullah bin Abu Bakar (berita), Amir bin Fuhairah (kambing), Abdullah bin Uraiqit (penunjuk jalan).

tip.en: Lesson pair: planning (ikhtiar) + trust in Allah (tawakal).
tip.bm: Pasangan pengajaran: perancangan (ikhtiar) + tawakal kepada Allah.

keyPoints.en: Masjid Quba' — first mosque; Masjid Nabawi — centre of the community.
keyPoints.bm: Masjid Quba' — masjid pertama; Masjid Nabawi — pusat masyarakat.

keyPoints.en: Market set up on fair, Islamic principles.
keyPoints.bm: Pasar diwujudkan berasaskan prinsip Islam yang adil.

keyPoints.en: Madinah Charter: first written constitution in the world.
keyPoints.bm: Piagam Madinah: perlembagaan bertulis pertama di dunia.

keyPoints.en: Gave rights and duties to Muslims, Jews and other residents.
keyPoints.bm: Memberi hak dan tanggungjawab kepada orang Islam, Yahudi dan penduduk lain.

keyPoints.en: Principles: religious freedom, joint defence, justice; the Prophet ﷺ as final authority.
keyPoints.bm: Prinsip: kebebasan beragama, pertahanan bersama, keadilan; Rasulullah ﷺ sebagai pihak berkuasa terakhir.
